lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in a repetitive, grid-like pattern posterior to the gills, with notable local maxima forming a semi-linear horizontal sequence along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the primary spot pattern, creating an orthogonal grid structure across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Parallel horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a distinct vertical luminance gradient with highlight on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Concentrated grouping of high-luminance circular blobs within the visible proximal and mid-regions of the dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated silhouettes clustered ventrally to the pectoral fin.
